item.title: Google Local Pack No Reviews Bug
item.content:encoded:
query: Google is not showing reviews in the local pack for some business listings that do indeed have reviews. Google shows "No reviews" with no stars in the local pack for these businesses, but when you click on the listing, Google does show that these businesses have reviews.关键词：Google、本地包、评论不显示、星级缺失、商家列表

总结: 1. Google本地包（local pack）对部分确有评论的商家列表不显示评论，仅显示“No reviews”且无星级。 2. 点击进入该商家列表详情页后，Google却正常显示这些商家拥有评论。 3. 该问题表现为本地包与详情页的评论展示不一致，属于展示异常。 4. 影响范围是部分商家列表，并非所有商家。 5. 需排查此类评论在本地包中未展示的原因。
Google is not showing reviews in the local pack for some business listings that do indeed have reviews. Google shows "No reviews" with no stars in the local pack for these businesses, but when you click on the listing, Google does show that these businesses have reviews.

item.title: ChatGPT Ads New Call-To-Actions, Business Agents Beyond US, More Audience Metrics & More
item.content:encoded:
ChatGPT广告；商业代理；行动号召；受众指标；政策中心

总结:OpenAI发布ChatGPT广告更新：1.商业代理扩展至美国以外；2.单图广告新增“了解更多”行动号召；3.Ads Manager和Ads API新增受众指标；4.促销结束后可隐藏产品目录销售价格；5.Ads Manager新增政策中心详情。
OpenAI just sent out a product update on ChatGPT Ads announcing that Business Agents expand outside the U.S., new learn more call-to-action added to single image ads, more audience metrics in Ads Manager and the Ads API, ability to hide product feed sale prices when a promotion ends and new policy center details in Ads Manager.

item.title: Google Ads Encourages Dynamically Scoring Conversion Values Hack
item.content:encoded:
Ginny Marvin、Google Ads、动态评分转化价值、非作弊、第一方数据

总结: 1. Google Ads联络人Ginny Marvin表示，平台“强烈鼓励”对转化价值进行动态评分。 2. 她明确表示，Google Ads不认为这种做法是任何形式的“作弊”。 3. 她补充，优化深层转化动作并输入高保真第一方数据，是引导系统理解你最重要价值的最佳方式。
Ginny Marvin, the Google Ads Liaison, said that the Google Ads platform "we strongly encourage" "dynamically scoring conversion values" and they do not consider it a "hack" of any kind. "Optimizing for deep conversion actions and feeding high-fidelity, first-party data is the best way to steer the system to what you value most," she added.

item.title: Bing Image Search Ask Visual Search Button
item.content:encoded:
微软、Bing搜索、图片悬停、Ask按钮、视觉搜索

总结: 1. 微软正在测试Bing搜索结果中鼠标悬停在图片上时出现的新按钮。2. 此前视觉搜索按钮点击后会跳转到新页面。3. 现在Ask按钮允许用户为该图片搜索补充查询上下文。
Microsoft seems to be testing a new button when you overlay your mouse cursor over an image in the Bing Search results. Previously, a visual search button took you to a new screen when clicked; now, an Ask button lets you add context to your query for that image search.

item.title: Google Image Collections & Saved Items Adds Ask Anything AI Mode
item.content:encoded: The Google Images collections & saved items section added an "Ask anything" button, where it will take all the images in the collection and let you ask Google AI Mode about them in one shot. Yes, Google is even sticking AI Mode into the images you save to your collections in Google Image Search.

item.title: Google On Inventory Pages Per Geographic Region: Fewer Pages Better
item.content:encoded: Google's John Mueller gave advice on how to handle inventory pages for each geographic area that you might have. Instead of creating a page for each product and geographic area with its inventory, create a single product page and show the inventory levels for that product in each location, without creating a new page for each location.

item.title: Google AdSense Opt-Out, Messaging & Privacy Updates
item.content:encoded: Google AdSense posted a few updates related to regulatory changes around opt-out controls, messaging and privacy regulations for the ad product. I figured I'd group them into one post and sum it up.

item.title: Google Snoopy Thanksgiving Prep 2026 Doodle
item.content:encoded: Tomorrow is Thanksgiving in the United States and Google is getting ready with a new Thanksgiving 2026 prep Doodle or logo. You can see the characters from Snoopy preparing the Thanksgiving table outside in this animated Doodle.

item.title: Google On How Links Are Selected & Shown In AI Overviews & AI Mode
item.content:encoded: As part of the updated documentation and Google Search ranking hub we covered a new document named Attribution and factuality in Search generative AI features. This document is chock-full of information on how Google selects which links to show in AI Mode, AI Overviews and other Search generative AI features.

item.title: New Google Search Ranking Hub, Ranking Principles, Feedback & AI Training Control
item.content:encoded: Google has launched a new Google Search ranking hub that acts as a unified Search ranking transparency hub on Search Central. The hub features consolidated information about Google's ranking systems, notice timelines, status dashboard updates, and structured feedback pathways in one central location.

item.title: Google December 2026 Core Update Preannounced - Complex Queries & Personalization
item.content:encoded: Google has preannounced the December 2026 core update, which is new for Google. The December 2026 core update is not live yet, but it will be live sometime in December. Google said this update "focuses on multiple improvements to how our systems understand and rank relevant content (including for longer and more complex questions), as well as improving personalized results for people who have personalization turned."

item.title: Bing AI Generated Answer - Different From AI Overviews/Copilot Search
item.content:encoded: Microsoft Bing is testing a new flavor of AI-generated answers that are labeled "AI-Generated answer" and seem to be different from the Bing AI Overviews and Copilot Search boxes.

item.title: Google Business Profiles Appeals Simplified Into A Single Form
item.content:encoded: Google has updated the appeals form in Google Business Profiles to a single form, replacing the previous multi-step workflow. This makes the process of submitting an appeal faster and simpler.

item.title: Google: People Don't Just Want AI, They Want AI & The Web
item.content:encoded: Elizabeth Reid, VP of Search at Google, was interviewed again and in this interview, she said that Google sees that "people don't want purely AI, they want AI and the web." She then goes on to explain this with examples of how some websites are easily replaceable with AI, while others are not.
